### workspace doctor --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace doctor [options]

Check that all required dependencies are installed and configured.

Options:
        --[no-]headless              Check for a headless setup (skips iTerm2 and window-tool), or not;
                                     default follows the same rule as 'workspace launch'
        --fix                        Link the workspace skills that are missing or dangling, route Claude's statusLine
                                     through 'workspace statusline' (backs up settings.json first), install Codex's hooks,
                                     and rewrite stale agent panes; everything else it reports is fixed by hand
        --json                       Print one JSON document with a row per check (see docs/README.doctor.md);
                                     exits 1 when a check failed

Examples:
  workspace doctor    # check the current machine's setup
  workspace doctor --json    # the same checks as one document
  workspace doctor --fix    # also fix what can be fixed: link the missing skills, set up Claude's status line and Codex's hooks, and update stale agent panes
  workspace doctor --headless    # check for a headless setup (skips iTerm2 and window-tool)
--- stderr
--- end
